name: Blue Sapphire
description: Sri Lanka's most famous gem. Fine cornflower-blue stones are the most valuable.
care: Clean with warm soapy water and a soft brush. Safe in ultrasonic cleaners if untreated.

name: Yellow Sapphire
description: A golden-yellow sapphire popular in jewellery and for astrological use.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft cloth. Avoid sudden temperature changes.

name: Pink Sapphire
description: Soft pink to hot pink sapphire, strong and durable for daily wear.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush.

name: White Sapphire
description: Colourless sapphire, often used as a diamond alternative.
care: Easy to clean with soapy water. Very hard and scratch resistant.

name: Padparadscha
description: Rare pink-orange sapphire named after the lotus blossom. One of the most valuable gems from Sri Lanka.
care: Clean gently with warm soapy water. Store separately in a soft pouch.

name: Star Sapphire
description: Shows a six-rayed star when cut as a cabochon and viewed under a single light.
care: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals.

name: Ruby
description: Red corundum. Sri Lankan rubies are usually lighter pink-red than Burmese stones.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush. Keep away from strong acids.

name: Cat's Eye
description: Chrysoberyl with a sharp light band that moves like a cat's eye. Honey and greenish-yellow are classic.
care: Wipe with a soft cloth. Avoid hard knocks.

name: Alexandrite
description: Rare colour-change gem: green in daylight and reddish-purple in incandescent light.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush.

name: Spinel
description: Bright, clean gem found in red, pink, blue and purple. Often mistaken for ruby in history.
care: Safe in warm soapy water. Avoid sudden heat changes.

name: Moonstone
description: Famous for its blue-white glow called adularescence. Meetiyagoda is well known for it.
care: Soft stone, so keep away from scratches and knocks. Clean with a soft damp cloth.

name: Hessonite Garnet
description: Honey-orange to reddish-brown garnet, also called cinnamon stone.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush.

name: Tourmaline
description: Comes in many colours, including green, pink and brown. Gets static charge when rubbed.
care: Warm soapy water. Avoid ultrasonic cleaners.

name: Topaz
description: Clear to golden gem with good hardness, but it can split along one direction if hit.
care: Clean with warm soapy water. Protect from hard knocks.

name: Aquamarine
description: Sea-blue to blue-green beryl, usually very clean and transparent.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush. Avoid heat.

name: Amethyst
description: Purple quartz and an affordable gem for beginners.
care: Keep out of strong sunlight because the colour can fade.

name: Citrine
description: Yellow to orange quartz, bright and affordable.
care: Warm soapy water. Avoid long exposure to heat.

name: Zircon
description: Natural zircon is a very brilliant gem, found in brown, yellow, green and blue. Not the same as synthetic cubic zirconia.
care: Brittle edges, so store apart from other gems. Clean with a soft cloth.

name: Kornerupine
description: A rare collector's gem in green and brown, with strong colour change in direction.
care: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Avoid ultrasonic cleaners.

name: Rose Quartz
description: Soft pink translucent quartz, usually used in beads and carvings.
care: Keep away from strong sunlight. Clean with a damp cloth.

name: Smoky Quartz
description: Grey-brown quartz, durable and common in jewellery.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush.

name: Iolite
description: Violet-blue gem that shows different colours from different angles.
care: Warm soapy water. Avoid ultrasonic cleaners.

name: Apatite
description: Neon blue-green gem that looks bright but is fairly soft.
care: Soft stone, so wear carefully and wipe with a damp cloth.

name: Almandine Garnet
description: Deep red garnet and one of the most common garnets in the market.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush.

name: Sphene
description: Also called titanite. Has very high fire and sparkle, but is soft.
care: Wear with care. Clean with a soft damp cloth only.

name: Scapolite
description: Yellow to pink gem, sometimes showing a cat's eye effect.
care: Soft cloth only. Avoid knocks and chemicals.

name: Sinhalite
description: First identified in Sri Lanka and named after the Sinhala people. Often mistaken for brown peridot.
care: Warm soapy water. Avoid hard knocks.

name: Andalusite
description: Shows different colours (green, brown, red) when turned in different directions.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush.

name: Sunstone
description: Orange feldspar with a glittering sparkle from tiny inclusions.
care: Soft stone, so keep away from scratches. Clean with a damp cloth.

name: Rhodolite Garnet
description: Raspberry pink-purple garnet that is bright and clean.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush.

name: Green Sapphire
description: Green corundum, often with a teal or bottle-green tone. Very durable for jewellery.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft brush.

name: Purple Sapphire
description: Violet to purple sapphire, sometimes showing a colour shift in different light.
care: Warm soapy water and a soft cloth.

name: Blue Spinel
description: A rarer blue form of spinel, bright and clean, sometimes mistaken for sapphire.
care: Warm soapy water. Avoid sudden heat changes.

name: Kyanite
description: Blue blade-like crystal. Its hardness changes with direction, so it can scratch easily.
care: Soft cloth only. Wear it carefully and store it apart from other gems.

name: Diopside
description: Deep green gem with a soft glow, suited to collectors rather than daily rings.
care: Soft stone. Clean with a damp cloth and avoid knocks.
